items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: George Nelson, that's a trombone player... Well I worked with him when he was in Sidney's band.

ctx.x: I got confused on that one.

Yeah, I played with George Augustine and Wilde with the band, and the voice band. Richard came after George. After George left the band. Then you went to what band? I left South the band was a small combination, you know. Oh, that's right. Kid Ranee, and the Chipsy T room. Kid Ranee's brother, I'm Joe Ranee. I was on the piano. I played Roy, Roy Evans on the drums, about four pieces. You didn't have any parents, no Reed or? Oh yeah, uh, oh, yes. Okay, of course, that's what I played. Now you had- Delarose. Oh.…

items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I used to play and substitute for their piano player.

ctx.x: And then we had something about Big L.O. Nelson too, you played with him.
Oh yeah, well I wasn't a regular member of that band. I used to play and substitute for their piano player.
